title: P1: METHOD_ROLES and register() can get out of sync silently
description:
Location: /crates/kith-jmap/src/lib.rs lines 222-238 (METHOD_ROLES), 283-285 (register), 335-352 (dispatch_one)

Risk: When a new JMAP method is added to the system:
1. Developer calls register("NewMethod/op", handler_box) to install handler
2. Developer FORGETS to add ("NewMethod/op", Role::X) to METHOD_ROLES static slice
3. Client request for NewMethod/op silently returns unknownMethod error (line 342)
4. No compiler warning, no runtime error — the handler is dead code
5. Mistake only discovered when testing, not at integration time

Root cause: register() and METHOD_ROLES are decoupled. Adding to one doesn't enforce adding to the other.

Suggested fix:
- Registry pattern: have JmapHandler trait include a role() method, eliminating the separate static table
- Or: use a macro that generates both the handler registration and METHOD_ROLES entry together
- Or: add a smoke test that asserts every registered handler has a METHOD_ROLES entry (weaker but easier to implement)
